description:
Goal
Make EmissionReadyProgram and BackendProgram preserve artifact-owned inventory while carrying transport-backed references/facts, not old recursive layouts, into downstream consumers.

Required change
EmissionReadyExecutable and BackendExecutable retain stable executable indexes, call edges, body inventory, value types/reprs that are true artifact facts, extern marshals, effects, and dispatch. Transport-owned movement facts are carried as plan revision plus ShapeId/TransportPosition/CallableId/BoundaryId/seam-fact references or explicit rows copied from TransportPlan for the handoff contract. BackendEntry origins and entry captures must name resume/capture transport positions or facts rather than TrashRuntimeValueLayout trees.

Deletion in the same commit
Remove runtime_params, return_layout, resume_layouts, entry_capture_layouts, TrashRuntimeParamLayout, TrashRuntimeInputLayout, TrashRuntimeValueLayout, TrashRuntimeLane, and TrashReturnAbi from live artifact structs once the equivalent handoff fact is plan-backed. Remove BackendEntryOrigin::DeliveredResume layout payloads and BackendEntry capture_layouts if they only mirror transport shape.

Downstream boundary
Do not solve native/interpreter/codegen value lowering here beyond what is necessary to compile against the new handoff. If a downstream consumer still walks TrashRealizedValue, TrashBackendValue, TrashDeliveredShape, or TrashNativeDemandAbi, leave that to fz-hwn.19.3-.19.5 with the exact new artifact fact it must read.

Tests
Assert emission/backend handoff inventory names the same ShapeId or transport position for producer return and delivered resume, and that callable entries/native-boundary inputs have BoundaryId-backed contracts rather than type-derived layout. Existing backend/native behavior tests may remain downstream red only when the failing code is outside artifact and has a named follow-up ticket.

Checks
Targeted artifact/backend tests; cargo check --all-targets; rg confirms live artifact structs and jobs no longer expose TrashRuntime* or TrashReturnAbi fields.
title: Artifact seam: carry transport-backed handoff through emission and backend
